slice: KinTale headline + pet-mood: add a real KinCareReport.title field (model + write path + composer editable input + report cover render) on all 3 platforms, and turn on the pet-mood pills (DefaultKinTaleTemplate petMoodEnabled=true + seeded moodOptions on web, promote the Android-already-built petMood authoring/render from a dead local const to live, and bind read-only mood pills to petMoodSelections on the web report screen).
summary: An auntie can type a headline/title for a KinTale in the composer; it persists on the report doc and renders as the cover hero on the report screen, with the existing "From {author} for {kinfolk}" line demoted to a sub-line. Pet-mood becomes live: the default template ships petMoodEnabled with mood options on every platform, the composer/report editor lets the auntie tap a mood pill per kin (writing petMoodSelections), and the sent report renders those mood pills. Both features are fail-loud: save errors surface as banners/toasts, and a mood section with no options or no selection shows nothing rather than faking data.
